docs.summary: An icon drawn from a stroked/filled SVG path in a 16x16 viewBox (Origami's default set).

members.name: SvgIcon
members.signature: public SvgIcon(string path, Color? color = null, bool fill = false, float scale = 1f)

params.path: SVG path data in a 16x16 viewBox (M/L/H/V/C/A/Z).
params.color: Fixed colour; when null the icon uses whatever colour the widget passes.
params.fill: Fill the path instead of stroking it.
params.scale: Fraction of the target rect's shorter side the glyph occupies (default 1).

docs.summary: Return a copy of this icon locked to `color`.

members.signature: public void Draw(Canvas canvas, Rect rect, Color color, float strokeWidth = 1.5f)
